title: adicea scrobiculata
intro: Adicea scrobiculata, commonly known as the "Yellow Myrobalan", is a plant species in the family Annonaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its health benefits, which include the ability to act as an antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent. The therapeutic actions of Adicea scrobiculata include its use in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its bioactive constituents which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Adicea scrobiculata, such as scopoletin and scopoletin glycosides, contribute to its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antiviral and anti-cancer activities.
